Add resources to graph

Source: R/AllGenerics.R, R/custom.R
addResource.Rd

addResource includes a user-defined resource to the ariadne graph.

Usage

addResource(graph, ...)

# S4 method for class 'igraph'
addResource(
  graph,
  by,
  file,
  res.name = "Custom",
  force = FALSE,
  timeout = 1e+06,
  ...
)

Arguments

graph

An igraph object.

...

Additional arguments passed to fread.

by

A formula specifying the custom path to add.

file

Character scalar. The path to a local or remote file that stores the linkmap between two features types corresponding by. It must be a table with two columns and each row representing a binding between features.

res.name

Character scalar. The name of the resource that will appear in the output graph. (Default: "Custom")

force

Logical scalar. Whether file should overwrite any previously cached files with the same name. (Default: FALSE)

timeout

Numeric scalar. The timeout for downloading resources. (Default: 1e6)

Value

An igraph object.

Examples

# Retrieve resource graph
graph <- ariadne()

# Set URL to custom resource
url <- "https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/amr_portal/releases/2025-12/"
url <- paste0(url, "phenotype_genotype_merged.csv.gz")

# Add resource to ariadne graph
graph <- addResource(
    graph,
    taxid ~ aro,
    url,
    res.name = "AMR",
    select = c("taxon_id", "antibiotic_ontology")
)

# Search for newly added path
searchPath(graph, taxid ~ aro)
#> Path 1:
#> taxid -(AMR)-> aro
#> 

# Plot newly added path
plotPath(graph, taxid ~ aro, focus = TRUE)
#> Using "stress" as default layout


# Find antibiotics related to E. coli (NCBI 562)
tax2aro <- weavePath(graph, taxid ~ aro, init = 562)
#> taxid -(AMR)-> aro
